title: 第5章 开局荒峰种猫草中第6章 开局荒峰种猫草下＆猫力打工奇观上
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
冰冷的雨水不知何时停了，铅灰色的云层依旧低垂，沉甸甸地压在废丹峰顶。
空气潮湿阴冷，弥漫着硝石、金属锈蚀和腐败药渣混合的刺鼻气味。
林墨站在山腰处一块相对避风的坡地前，脚下是灰黑色、板结如同岩石的硬土。
他的目光死死盯着刚才灵雨滴落的地方——那个针尖大小的深色湿点，在灰败的背景中微弱得几乎要消失，却是这片死寂荒山中唯一的生迹标记。
“就是这里！”
林墨舔了舔干裂的嘴唇，眼中燃烧着孤注一掷的火焰。
他放下那个装着猫薄荷灵种的、散发着诱人清香的布袋，小心翼翼地放在一块还算干净的石头上。
现在，他需要一块能种下种子的“田”
没有锄头，没有铲子。
他环顾四周，目光扫过遍地狼藉的丹炉碎片和废弃药渣堆。
最终，他捡起一块边缘相对锋利的、巴掌大小的黑褐色丹炉残片，又寻来几块趁手的、拳头大小的石头。
就是它们了！
原始的开荒工具！
他选定以那个微小的湿点为中心，圈出一块大约半张桌子大小的区域。
这里碎石相对较少，地势微微内凹，能避开最猛烈的山风，算是这片绝地里难得的“风水宝地”
了。
开干！
林墨深吸一口气，握紧那块锋利的丹炉碎片，蹲下身，用尽全力朝着板结的硬土凿下去！
“锵！”
一声刺耳的金石交击声！

碎片边缘与硬土猛烈碰撞，溅起几点火星！
巨大的反震力顺着碎片传到林墨手上，震得他虎口发麻，指骨生疼！
再看地面，只留下一个浅浅的白印和几道细微的裂痕！
这土……简直比铁还硬！
饥饿带来的虚弱感阵阵袭来，胃里火烧火燎。
但他咬紧牙关，再次举起碎片，更用力地凿下！
“锵！
锵！
锵！”
单调而刺耳的敲击声，在死寂的废丹峰山腰孤独地回荡。
每一次敲击都伴随着手臂的酸痛和虎口的剧震。
汗水很快浸透了他单薄的衣衫，混合着之前淋湿的雨水，黏腻冰冷地贴在身上。
头顶那对黑色的猫耳，因为全神贯注和用力而微微向后绷紧，警惕地竖立着。
进展缓慢得令人绝望。
大半天过去，他才勉强用碎片和石头“凿”
开了一小片地表的硬壳，清理出脸盆大小的地方，下面依旧是板结的硬土，而且混杂着更多细小的碎石。
“呼…呼…”
content_en:
The cold rain stopped at some point, but the leaden gray clouds were still hanging low, weighing heavily on the top of Feidan Peak.
The air was damp and cold, filled with the pungent smell of saltpeter, metal rust, and rotten medicinal residues.
Lin Mo stood in front of a relatively sheltered slope on the mountainside. Under his feet was gray-black hard soil as hard as rock.
His eyes were fixed on the place where the spiritual rain had just fallen - the dark wet spot the size of a needle tip, so faint that it almost disappeared in the gray background, but it was the only sign of life in this dead and barren mountain.
"This is it!"
Lin Mo licked his chapped lips, eyes burning with desperate flames.
He put down the cloth bag containing the catnip seeds, which exuded an alluring fragrance, and carefully placed it on a relatively clean stone.
Now, he needs a "field" where he can plant seeds
No hoe, no shovel.
He looked around, scanning the scattered fragments of the alchemy furnace and the piles of discarded medicine dregs.
Finally, he picked up a palm-sized dark brown alchemy furnace fragment with a relatively sharp edge, and found a few fist-sized stones that came to hand.
That’s it!
The original land reclamation tool!
He selected the tiny wet spot as the center and circled an area about half the size of a table.
There are relatively few gravels here, and the terrain is slightly concave, which can avoid the strongest mountain winds. It can be regarded as a rare "feng shui treasure land" in this Jedi.
.
Get started!
Lin Mo took a deep breath, grasped the sharp fragment of the alchemy furnace, squatted down, and used all his strength to dig into the hardened soil!
"Qiang!"
A harsh sound of metal and stone clashing!
The edge of the debris collided violently with the hard soil, causing a few sparks to fly!
The huge repulsive force was transmitted along the fragments to Lin Mo's hands, making his jaw numb and his finger bones painful!
Looking at the ground again, there was only a shallow white mark and a few tiny cracks left!
This soil... is simply harder than iron!
The weakness caused by hunger came over me in waves, and my stomach was on fire.
But he gritted his teeth, lifted the fragment again, and chipped it off harder!
"Qiang!
Clang!
Clang! "
The monotonous and harsh knocking sound echoed lonely on the dead silent mountainside of Feidan Peak.
Every blow was accompanied by soreness in the arm and a sharp shock in the tiger's mouth.
Sweat quickly soaked through his thin clothes, mixed with the rain that had soaked him before, and clung to his body with a sticky coldness.
The pair of black cat ears on the top of his head were slightly stretched back due to concentration and exertion, and stood up vigilantly.
Progress is hopelessly slow.
Most of the day passed before he managed to "chisel" it with fragments and stones.
A small area of hard crust on the surface was opened, and an area the size of a washbasin was cleared. There was still hard hard soil underneath, mixed with more tiny gravels.
"Huh...huh..."
